requirements.title: TRANSPOSE result characteristics
requirements.definition: The result has the same type and type parameters as MATRIX, rank two, and shape [n,m] for MATRIX shape [m,n].

pending.TRANSPOSE-result-same-type-parameters: Use a character(len=4) rank-two MATRIX with nonblank elements; assert LEN of result elements is four and values follow the p5 mapping.
pending.TRANSPOSE-result-rank-two-shape-reversed: Use integer MATRIX declared A(-1:1,5:6) with shape [3,2]; assert SHAPE(TRANSPOSE(A))==[2,3]. Include zero-extent companion MATRIX(1:0,5:7) with shape [0,3] and assert result shape [3,0].

requirements.title: TRANSPOSE result value uses reversed subscripts with MATRIX lower bounds
requirements.definition: Element (i,j) of the result has value MATRIX(j+LBOUND(MATRIX,1)-1, i+LBOUND(MATRIX,2)-1).

pending.TRANSPOSE-values-use-reversed-subscripts: Use integer A(-1:1,5:6) with distinct values A(-1,5)=15, A(0,5)=25, A(1,5)=35, A(-1,6)=16, A(0,6)=26, A(1,6)=36; assert TRANSPOSE(A) has rows [15,25,35] and [16,26,36], then mutate the expected row order.
pending.TRANSPOSE-zero-size-result-has-reversed-: Use integer B(1:0,5:7) and assert SIZE(TRANSPOSE(B))==0 plus SHAPE [3,0], paired with the nonzero A case so zero size is not vacuous.
